threeMRemoval.reason: Angel One never served 3m (verified live 2026-09-12: 0 bars). Upstox served it but coverage was minimal (10,125 rows, 9 instruments). No strategy uses 3m. No ML feature uses 3m. 3m is not a valid Alphaforge interval.
threeMRemoval.legacyRowsInDbAllowed: Yes — existing rows are immutable audit records. No new 3m data is acquired.
threeMRemoval.typeSystemEnforcement: Interval union in src/lib/market-data/types.ts does NOT include '3m'. TypeScript compiler rejects '3m' at compile time.
threeMRemoval.runtimeEnforcement: isSupportedInterval('3m') === false. assertSupportedInterval('3m') throws. Python validate_interval('3m') raises ValueError.
threeMRemoval.apiEnforcement: All historical-data API endpoints return HTTP 400 for timeframe=3m.
threeMRemoval.mlEnforcement: CanonicalDecision.__post_init__ raises if timeframe='3m'. validate_canonical_data_v8 returns BLOCKED for 3m.
threeMRemoval.occurrencesAllowedInTests: Only as rejection assertions (tests proving 3m IS rejected)
threeMRemoval.occurrencesAllowedInLegacyData: Existing CandleBar rows with intervalStr='3m' are immutable audit records
threeMRemoval.binanceKlineInterval3m: RETAINED — Binance legitimately uses 3m. KlineInterval != Interval (different type).
threeMRemoval.deltaResolution3m: RETAINED — Delta exchange broker uses 3m. Separate type from NSE Interval.
